description.zh: 应用ID。 默认取值：**app-1000000**。使用说明，请参见[多应用](~~113600~~)。
description.en: The application ID. The default value is **app-1000000**. For more information, see [Multi-application management](~~113600~~).

description.zh:
播放密钥。
- 仅支持大小写字母和数字，长度在8 ~ 20个字符之间。
- UTF-8 编码。
description.en:
The playback key.

- The key must be 8 to 20 characters in length and can contain only uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits.

- The key must be UTF-8 encoded.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod set-app-play-key --app-id app-1000231 --play-key yzNgTUtAl6HAuosIA --region cn-hangzhou
